en: Black‑and‑white view down a gently curving cobblestone street in a European town. On the right is a row of ornate historic townhouses with arched windows and classical detailing; on the left, leafy trees and simpler houses. At the end of the street stands a massive, steep‑roofed medieval building that resembles part of a castle or fortress complex. There are a few streetlamps and potted plants, but no visible cars, suggesting an early 20th‑century scene.
